answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: It puts 'Fix before launch (members will fail or get the wrong result)' items 1-4 ahead of 'Fix next' and 'Smaller things', with a 'Suggested order' that calls items 1 and 2 the riskiest. It names what it could not check and leaves for a person: "I didn't test with VoiceOver or TalkBack, or in Safari's date picker, so a real run on an iPhone and an Android phone is still worth doing."

mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only on the confirm page
mapping.reason: The tool page "offers all 21 days"; a closed Friday 16 was refused only at the last step ("The library is closed on Friday 16 October… Choose another day.") and "That error has no link", the only fix being to go back to the tool page. That is D06's closed day accepted and refused three steps later with no way back.

mapping.title: Pick-up date asked twice, on the tool page and again in the basket
mapping.reason: "The basket then asks again, separately, for a 'pick-up session'", with the fix "ask once… carry that choice through so the basket just shows it". That is D23: the member enters the same date a second time, in another form.

mapping.title: Tool-page day and basket session never checked against each other
mapping.reason: "The two choices are never checked against each other"; in the change-session case the confirm page shows "pick up Saturday 17 October" beside the session "Wednesday 21 October". That is D15's own example of unreconciled dates shown side by side.

mapping.title: Calendar allows days before the tool's 'Available from' date
mapping.reason: "the sander isn't available until 21 Oct, but 10 Oct can be chosen", with the fix to offer only days on or after "Available from" and only sessions every item can make. Same problem as D14's unmarked, unchecked days before availability.

mapping.title: Unshown 10-minute hold; basket stuck on 'Something went wrong'
mapping.reason: The hold "starts when the first tool is added and is never reset", after 10 minutes Continue says "Something went wrong. Try again." every time, and "The time limit is also never shown". That is D10's hidden hold and misleading lapse error.

mapping.title: Confirm button stays active; a double tap makes two reservations
mapping.reason: "the button stays active during that wait", "One double tap produced 'Reservation numbers: FT-4471 and FT-4472'" and "no visible sign that anything is happening": D12. "Do the same for Continue on the basket page" only widens the same missing busy state.

mapping.title: Truncated names make the two drills look identical
mapping.reason: At 375 px "'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' appears twice, so a member can't tell the two-battery drill from the one-battery one": D03 exactly.

mapping.title: Search box below all ten cards on a phone; icon-only Filters
mapping.reason: "The search box is about 2,100 px down, after all ten cards", a focus order that "doesn't match what's on screen", and the fix to put search first and give "Filters" a visible text label: D01's list-before-search reorder with an icon-only filter button. The review places the focus mismatch on desktop, but its fix covers D01.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails contrast
mapping.reason: "Green text #2f7d4a on #1d2622 has a contrast of 3.07:1, against a required 4.5:1", leaving "available soon" the least noticeable badge in dark mode: D04. The untinted badge background is the same badge and the same harm.

mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse date order, against focus order
mapping.reason: Sessions run "28 Oct at the top down to 10 Oct at the bottom" and "Keyboard and screen-reader order is the reverse (flex-direction: row-reverse; flex-wrap: wrap-reverse)": D11.

mapping.title: A search with no matches shows and announces nothing
mapping.reason: "'hammer' … leaves all 10 tools on screen, and nothing is announced", with the fix to show "No tools match 'hammer'". That is D02's silent no-match that leaves the old list in place.

mapping.title: Search matches only the exact phrase typed
mapping.reason: The review shows "drill with two batteries" finds nothing although "Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries" exists, and asks to "match each word separately". Members who describe a tool in their own words (the two-battery drill is the main scenario) cannot find it; D02 covers only the missing no-match message, not the matching.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' gives only a 1.2-second toast
mapping.reason: "gives a 1.2-second toast and nothing else… disappears too fast to read on a phone… no clear next step except the 'Basket (1)' link": the brief feedback after the press (D07). It does not argue that members believe the tool is already reserved, so not D26.

mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps keyboard users
mapping.reason: "Tab and Escape just cycle between the options; I tested this": D09's custom listbox that a keyboard user cannot leave. "Clicking outside doesn't close it either" is the same missing dismissal, fixed by the same native select.

mapping.title: Membership and mobile number formats too strict
mapping.reason: "It rejects 'ft-01234' and '07700 900 123'", with the fix to accept any capitalisation and any spacing: D17.

mapping.title: 'Change' returns to the basket with no session selected
mapping.reason: "'Change' goes to the basket with no session pre-selected", with the fix "pass slot back": D13.

mapping.title: 'Change' wipes the name and number already typed
mapping.reason: "it loses the name and number already typed", with the fix "keep the details in sessionStorage": D22's confirm fields coming back empty after Change.

mapping.title: Rename the 'Change' link to 'Change session'
mapping.reason: A bare wording suggestion with no harm stated; the link sits beside the pick-up session, so what it changes is clear from context, and the rename would not fix the dropped session (D13).

mapping.title: Pages scroll sideways at 200% zoom
mapping.reason: "The find page is 346 px wide in a 187 px viewport, because of minmax(330px, 1fr)", with the fix minmax(min(330px,100%),1fr): D05's 330 px minimum grid columns that overflow at 320 px and at 200% zoom. The other pages' overflow is a broader statement of the same reflow problem.

mapping.title: Basket not cleared after confirming
mapping.reason: "After confirming, the basket still shows 'Basket (1)'": D18.

mapping.title: Reservation number looks like a membership number
mapping.reason: "'FT-4471' uses the same prefix as 'FT-01234'": the member types one FT- number on the confirm page and is given another on the done page, so at collection they may quote the wrong one and a volunteer cannot tell at a glance which it is. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Three-tool maximum stated but not enforced
mapping.reason: "The 'maximum three tools' rule is stated but not enforced": D21.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice
mapping.reason: "Screen readers hear the tool name twice on the done page, because of the hidden #c-tool copy": D24.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar covers the footer phone number
mapping.reason: "The sticky 'Reserve this tool' bar covers the footer phone number at the bottom of the tool page", with the fix of bottom padding equal to the bar's height: D08's fixed bar that nothing keeps the page clear of, whose phone case is the footer and desk phone number under the bar. The review misses the focus-obscured part.
